SELECT f.favoriteID AS favoriteId, v.videoID AS videoId, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, v.videoImgUrl AS videoImgUrl, TIME_FORMAT(v.duration, '%H:%i:%s') AS duration, u.userID AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.imgUrl AS authorAvatarUrl, v.viewCount AS viewCount, v.likeCount AS likeCount, f.favoriteDate AS favoriteDate FROM favorite f INNER JOIN video v ON f.videoID = v.videoID AND v.enable = 1 INNER JOIN `user` u ON v.userID = u.userID WHERE f.userID = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1
AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.favoriteDate DESC

SELECT v.videoID AS videoId, v.userID AS userId, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, TIME_FORMAT(v.duration, '%H:%i:%s') AS duration, v.uploadDate AS uploadDate, v.videoSrcUrl AS videoSrcUrl, v.videoImgUrl AS videoImgUrl, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.imgUrl AS authorAvatarUrl, c.categoryID AS categoryId, c.categoryName AS categoryName, v.viewCount AS viewCount, v.likeCount AS likeCount, v.favoriteCount AS favoriteCount, v.barrageCount AS barrageCount, v.commentCount AS commentCount, v.reviewStatus AS reviewStatus FROM favorite f INNER JOIN video v ON f.videoID = v.videoID AND v.enable = 1 INNER JOIN `user` u ON v.userID = u.userID LEFT JOIN videocategory vc ON v.videoID = vc.videoID AND vc.enable = 1 LEFT JOIN categorie c ON vc.categoryID = c.categoryID WHERE f.userID = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 ORDER BY f.favoriteDate DESC LIMIT #{limit}
